privacy.description: At Giftisan, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the creative and personal information you share with us.
privacy.more_details_desc: We are happy to provide detailed information about our data encryption and security standards.
privacy.section1_desc: We collect information you provide directly to us: name, email address, payment information, and product details. We also collect usage data to improve your browsing experience.
privacy.section2_desc: Your data is used to process transactions, fulfill orders, and communicate with you about your account. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.section3_desc: We share necessary details (like shipping address) with artisans to ensure your handcrafted items are delivered. We also use secure third-party payment processors like Stripe.
privacy.section4_desc: We implement robust security protocols, including encryption and secure server environments, to protect your sensitive data from unauthorized access.
privacy.section5_desc: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time. You can manage your notification preferences directly in your profile settings.

terms.description: Effective starting April 2026. Please read these terms carefully to understand your rights and obligations while using the Giftisan platform.
terms.questions_desc: We're here to help clarify any aspect of our platform agreement.
terms.section1_desc: By accessing or using the Giftisan platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to any part of these terms, you may not use our services.
terms.section2_desc: Giftisan is a platform that connects independent artisans (Sellers) with customers (Buyers). Giftisan does not manufacture or store the items sold; we provide the platform for transaction and connection.
terms.section3_desc: Artisans must ensure all products are handcrafted or vintage. They are responsible for accurate descriptions, shipping, and fulfilling orders in a timely manner. Giftisan reserves the right to remove any listing that violates our quality standards.
terms.section4_desc: Giftisan processes payments through secure third-party providers. For the duration of 2026, Giftisan collects 0% platform commission on all sales — artisans keep 100% of their earnings. Buyers are responsible for the purchase price and any applicable shipping costs. Commission terms may be updated for future periods and will be disclosed in advance.
terms.section5_desc: Artisans retain ownership of their designs. By listing products, artisans grant Giftisan a license to use product photos for marketing and promotional purposes. Users may not copy or redistribute content without permission.

shipping.description: Giftisan is currently in a manual fulfillment phase. We are committed to ensuring your artisanal products reach you safely and efficiently.
shipping.more_details_desc: If you have specific questions about a shipment or international delivery, our team is ready to assist.
shipping.section1_desc: Since we are in our launch phase, shipping is currently handled manually by our artisans. Once you place an order, the artisan will contact you to coordinate the best delivery method.
shipping.section2_desc: We primarily serve all major cities in Egypt. For international shipping inquiries, please contact the artisan directly through the 'Message Artisan' feature on their product page.
shipping.section3_desc: Each product is handcrafted. Processing times vary depending on the item's complexity and the artisan's current workload, typically ranging from 3 to 10 business days.
shipping.section4_desc: We encourage all our artisans to use sustainable, eco-friendly packaging that protects your product while respecting the environment.
shipping.section5_desc: We are actively working on integrating automated payment systems to provide a seamless experience for both collectors and creators in the near future.

refund.description: At Giftisan, we stand by the quality of our master craftsmanship. Our refund policy is designed to be fair to both collectors and creators.
refund.more_details_desc: If you have specific questions about a return or a refund request, our support team is here to help.
refund.section1_desc: Because each item is handcrafted specifically for you, we only offer refunds for items that arrive damaged or significantly different from their description. Change-of-mind returns are generally not accepted.
refund.section2_desc: If your product arrives damaged, please contact the artisan through the platform within 48 hours of delivery. Please include clear photos of the damage and the packaging.
refund.section3_desc: Once a claim is verified, the artisan may offer a repair, a replacement, or a partial/full refund. Giftisan will assist in mediating if a direct resolution between the buyer and artisan cannot be reached.
refund.section4_desc: If a return is required for a refund, the buyer is typically responsible for return shipping costs unless the item was damaged upon arrival or significantly misrepresented.
refund.section5_desc: Approved refunds are processed back to the original payment method within 5-10 business days of the return being received or the claim being finalized.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Giftisan is Egypt's premiere marketplace for unique, handcrafted gifts. We connect independent Egyptian artisans with collectors who appreciate authentic, soulful craftsmanship.
faq.q2: Where do the products come from?
faq.a2: Every piece on Giftisan is handmade by local independent artisans across Egypt, from Cairo and Alexandria to Fayoum and Upper Egypt.
faq.a3: Yes, we facilitate shipping to all governorates within Egypt, ensuring your handcrafted products reach you safely.
faq.q4: How can I join as an artisan?
faq.a4: Independent Egyptian makers can apply to open their own studio through our Artisan Portal. We look for authentic, high-quality handcrafted work.

brand_story.title: Our Heart & Soul
brand_story.subtitle: Connecting the threads of Egyptian heritage with modern collectors.
brand_story.description: Giftisan was born out of a deep respect for the master makers of Egypt. Our mission is to provide a premiere digital home for the independent artisans who keep our culture alive. Every product found here is a testament to the skill, patience, and passion of an Egyptian maker. When you shop on Giftisan, you aren't just buying a product—you are supporting a dream and preserving a legacy.
